items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: They said, well what's the name of this? See, because it was (Firrn?) and Rockwell was handling, and had an engineer, forget his name.

ctx.x: See, we rehearsed that in Lil's front room because she had a brand new baby grand piano and Fatha Hines sure did love that piano. And another thing, old Jelly Roll loved that piano. He sure did love that piano.

Well anyway, a lot of times we wouldn't name down those tunes until we got to the studio. We'd figure out a name for it. Like 'Muggles' and things like that. Oh so many other things. We wouldn't put the name on them until we recorded them at times. They said, well what's the name of this? See, because it was (Firrn?) and Rockwell was handling, and had an engineer, forget his name.
